Manage organizations and users. Requires admin API key.

Usage:
  trace admin [command]

Available Commands:
  org         Manage organizations
  rotate-key  Rotate API key for a user
  user        Manage users

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for admin

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace admin [command] --help" for more information about a command.
